highlights.title: Executor sub-agent tool calls (saved transcripts)
highlights.detail: across 299 transcripts; per-day split not reliable (see notes)

notes.toolCalls: Connector (MCP) calls + shell commands + browser visits + computer-use sessions from each bot's audit.jsonl.
notes.filesWritten: Output-file writes Bot Island attributes to a bot by folder pattern, de-duplicated to one per minute, last 30 days only. Bots without mapped folders show 0, which means not measured, not zero.
notes.messages: Bot-to-bot message metadata (who and when) from each bot's transcript store. No contents.
notes.subagents: Executor sub-agent transcripts carry no per-line timestamps and no parent-bot field, so they are not credited to a bot. Shared restore mtimes make per-day splits unreliable.
notes.noAudit: No audit.jsonl on disk for: Engineering Lead, Boyd Family Times, TokenMax, Pods, Path. A 0 for those bots means not measured, not zero activity.
notes.thisWeek: Projects whose newest file mtime is on/after the Thu Oct 8 ~7:42 PM ET weekly reset. 'Hot' = remastered or newly built on/after Fri Oct 9 (after the Oct 8 ~8:11 PM unpack). Many folders share an Oct 8 8:11 PM ET mtime from that unpack — they count as This Week on-disk but are not marked hot. Counts use hub/scan.py rules.
notes.buildNightArchive: Frozen Oct 7 6:04 PM ET totals from the TokenMax-Oct7-build.zip snapshot. Live mtimes cannot recover Oct 7 after the Oct 8 unpack rewrote them. liveTotals = current disk stats for those same 35 project names.
notes.auditGap: The latest mcp/shell/browser/computer-use event in any audit.jsonl is 2026-09-15. This week's sparkline therefore uses scored fleet actions (tool calls + routine runs + files written + bot msgs) from Bot Island events, which still include Oct 8–10 activity even when the raw tool-call stream is quiet.
